data.one_liner: Password strength estimator inspired by password crackers
data.what_it_does: Evaluates password strength using pattern matching, common dictionaries, dates, repeats, and sequences. Provides a numeric score and feedback localization support.
use_when: You want to replace rigid password composition rules with secure, flexible strength estimation
You need localized password feedback and dictionary support
avoid_when: You do not need to evaluate password strength or quality
strengths: More secure and flexible than basic password complexity rules
Includes localization support and multiple language dictionaries
weaknesses: Requires manual specification of dictionaries for effective scoring
